bluf: Deutsche Welle reported Iran claimed it struck US radar systems in Bahrain; The Guardian reported Iran’s Revolutionary Guard said it targeted and destroyed an early-warning radar there, while the US said it intercepted the attacks. France 24 reported US flights were resuming after a nationwide ground stop, with more than 2,000 cancellations as airlines worked to return to normal operations. France 24 reported the White House confirmed a planned meeting of Trump, Xi and Putin in Shenzhen on Thursday, with nuclear weapons and the war in Iran among likely discussion topics.

items.text: France 24 reported the White House confirmed Trump, Xi and Putin are scheduled to meet in Shenzhen on Thursday, with nuclear weapons and the war in Iran among likely discussion topics; BBC News reported Trump would discuss reducing nuclear weapons.

Deutsche Welle reported Iran claimed it struck US radar systems in Bahrain, while the US said it intercepted the attacks; The Guardian reported Iran’s Revolutionary Guard said it targeted and destroyed a US early-warning radar there. The reports differ on the claimed outcome.

France 24 reported US flights were resuming after a nationwide ground stop, with more than 2,000 cancellations as airlines worked to return to normal operations; it reported nearly 6,000 flights were cancelled on Friday.
According to Deutsche Welle, international aid cuts are worsening Sudan’s humanitarian crisis; almost 34 million people are in need, while war and drone strikes make aid delivery difficult.

BBC News reported Microsoft said efforts to address the underlying problem with Outlook, Teams and Copilot were complete; France 24 and The Guardian also reported the company said services were restored.
